preconditions.expression: 1 <= m <= 1000 and all(1 <= s_i <= 10**6 for s_i in s) and len(s) == m and s == sorted(s)
preconditions.description: The input consists of an integer m (1 ≤ m ≤ 1000) and a strictly increasing list s of m integers (1 ≤ s_i ≤ 10^6).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == '-1') or (all(line.strip() in ('-1', str(n), ' '.join(map(str, a))) for line in stdout.splitlines()) and (n == len(a) if n != -1 else True) and all(1 <= x <= 10**6 for x in a) and n <= 4000 if n != -1 else True)
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' (no solution) or a valid sequence of length n ≤ 4000 with elements 1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^6, or n = -1 if no solution exists.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == '-1') or (set(gcd(*a[i:j+1]) for i in range(len(a)) for j in range(i, len(a))) == set(s))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the sequence a must produce exactly the set S when computing all possible contiguous subarray GCDs.
